purpose: Constrain environmental role without absolute-background assumptions or detector detour

source_roles.XXV_A4_A5: dependent balance and unresolved environmental modes
source_roles.IC16_IC17: versioned identity state and physical-normalization gaps

resolved_identity: x: deviations of declared geometry/history coordinates; scalar q is a restricted sector
resolved_environment: y or u: selected response mode, not automatically thermodynamic entropy, pressure or ARK Delta S_t
reference: joint stationary supported state; preserve linear terms if constraints/preloads require them
conditions: same reference when comparing clamped and relaxed response
all reference/control quantities fixed independently of target
added_kinetics: q_dot=-M(Aq-gu); u_dot=-L(Bu-gq), M,L>0; not source-canonical kinetics
spatial_extension: positive Gq,Gu gradient penalties; boundary conditions specified
scalar_summary_test: rank <=1 necessary locally for all considered outputs to factor through one smooth scalar; check full fibers/response conditions separately
partition_rule: S+epsilon only when same coupling, scale, geometry and timing represented
normalization_degeneracy: u->alpha*u with compensating B,Gu,g,L leaves identity response unchanged
next_gate: physically ground one constitutive/coupling and normalization map; retain all nonidentified directions and test a distinct observable
